senses.en: physical activity, or a piece of work to practise
to do physical activity

ex.en: Morning exercise is in the yard.
ex.zh: 早晨锻炼在院子里。

ex.en: An exercise book full of copies is not the same as one hard problem done slowly.
ex.zh: 一本抄满的练习册，不等于慢慢做完的一道难题。

tip: exercise 作“锻炼”时常不可数；作“习题”时可数。也可作动词。

senses.en: not hard, or not loud or bright

ex.en: The ground is soft after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后地面很软。

ex.en: Soft light in a hallway can save energy and still show the step.
ex.zh: 走廊里柔和的灯可以省电，同时仍然照得见台阶。

tip: soft drink 是不含酒精的饮料。表里没有单独的 soft 音标行，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: an upright side of a room or a barrier

ex.en: The notice is on the wall.
ex.zh: 通知在墙上。

ex.en: A high wall around a school can keep children safe and also hide the street they need to learn.
ex.zh: 学校周围的高墙可以保护孩子，也会挡住他们需要认识的街道。

tip: 在墙上用 on the wall。

senses.en: normal, not special

ex.en: It was an ordinary Monday.
ex.zh: 那是一个普通的周一。

ex.en: Ordinary help, such as holding a door, matters as much as a speech.
ex.zh: 扶门这样的普通帮助，和一篇讲话一样重要。

tip: extraordinary 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: working by itself

ex.en: The door is automatic.
ex.zh: 这扇门是自动的。

ex.en: An automatic reply is not a person who can change the bus time.
ex.zh: 自动回复不是一个能改公交时间的人。

tip: automatic 也可作名词，较少用。

senses.en: a weapon that shoots

ex.en: The museum does not allow a gun in the building.
ex.zh: 博物馆不允许把枪带进楼里。

ex.en: A history lesson about a gun should also ask who was harmed, not only how the machine worked.
ex.zh: 关于枪的历史课也应该问谁受到了伤害，而不只是机器如何工作。

tip: gun 是可数名词。

senses.en: to feel that something is important
attention or looking after someone

ex.en: She cares about every student in the class.
ex.zh: 她关心班上的每一个学生。

ex.en: People care more about a park when they helped plant the trees than when they only walk past it.
ex.zh: 人们如果参与种过树，会比只是路过时更在意一座公园。

tip: care for 可以是照顾，也可以是“喜欢”，要看语境。

senses.en: imagination, or a story that is not real

ex.en: The story is a fantasy, not a plan.
ex.zh: 这个故事是幻想，不是计划。

ex.en: Fantasy can open a class, and the bus time still has to be real.
ex.zh: 幻想可以打开一节课，公交时间却必须是真的。

tip: fantasy 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: of the colour of gold, or excellent

ex.en: The golden light lasted ten minutes.
ex.zh: 金色的光持续了十分钟。

ex.en: A golden chance to fix the roof comes before the rainy season, not after the first leak.
ex.zh: 修屋顶的黄金机会在雨季之前，而不是第一次漏水之后。

tip: golden 多形容颜色或比喻“极好”。金子本身用 gold。

senses.en: based on ideas, not on a physical thing
a short account of a longer text

ex.en: The word is too abstract for the first line.
ex.zh: 这个词对第一行来说太抽象。

ex.en: The idea stayed abstract until they drew a picture of it.
ex.zh: 这个想法在画出来之前一直很抽象。

tip: abstract 作名词是摘要。

senses.en: the larger part of a group

ex.en: The majority of students walk or cycle.
ex.zh: 大多数学生步行或骑车。

ex.en: A majority vote can still be unfair if the people most affected were not in the room.
ex.zh: 如果受影响最大的人不在房间里，多数票仍然可能不公平。

tip: the majority of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数。

senses.en: colored liquid used for writing or printing

ex.en: This pen has run out of ink.
ex.zh: 这支笔没墨水了。

ex.en: Blue ink soaked through the page and made the notes on the back unreadable.
ex.zh: 蓝墨水浸透了那一页，背面的笔记没法看了。

col: a bottle of ink｜一瓶墨水
tip: 用钢笔写是 write in ink。打印机里的是 ink cartridge。

senses.en: one of the five parts at the end of the hand

ex.en: She pointed with one finger.
ex.zh: 她用一根手指指着。

ex.en: A cut on a finger in the lab is a reason to stop and wash it.
ex.zh: 实验室里手指被划伤，是停下来清洗的理由。

tip: finger 通常不含拇指时有人用 thumb 单指拇指。本条按一般“手指”处理。

senses.en: a way of showing ideas or feelings, or a look on the face

ex.en: Her expression showed she was tired.
ex.zh: 她的表情说明她累了。

ex.en: Freedom of expression at school still has a limit: no one may threaten a classmate.
ex.zh: 学校里的表达自由仍有界限：谁也不能威胁同学。

tip: 动词 express 已在本库。expression 也可指固定说法。

senses.en: to feel anxious about something
a problem that makes you anxious

ex.en: Do not worry about the result tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚先别为结果担心。

ex.en: Parents worry when the last bus is cancelled and the school has not sent a message.
ex.zh: 末班车取消而学校又没发消息时，家长会担心。

tip: worry 后接 about。形容词 worried 形容人，worrying 形容事情。

senses.en: thin cord, or the part of an instrument you play

ex.en: The parcel is tied with string.
ex.zh: 包裹用细绳捆着。

ex.en: A broken string on the guitar is a reason to borrow another, not to cancel the song.
ex.zh: 吉他断了一根弦，是再借一把的理由，不是取消这首歌。

col: a piece of string｜一根绳子
tip: string 作绳子时常不可数。乐器的弦可数。

senses.en: money gained after costs

ex.en: The book fair made a small profit.
ex.zh: 书展有了一小笔利润。

ex.en: A profit from the canteen should be explained to the students who paid for lunch.
ex.zh: 食堂的利润应当向付钱吃午饭的学生说明。

tip: profit 作动词是获益。profit from something。

senses.en: causing pain and not caring

ex.en: The rule felt cruel.
ex.zh: 这条规则让人觉得残忍。

ex.en: A cruel joke about a classmate is not one the class should keep.
ex.zh: 针对同学的残忍笑话，不是班级该保留的。

tip: cruel 可以形容行为。用在人身上要慎重。

senses.en: a large boat

ex.en: The ship left the port at dawn.
ex.zh: 船在黎明离开了港口。

ex.en: Goods on a ship still need a road at the other end if a village is to receive them.
ex.zh: 如果一个村子要收到货物，船上的货在另一头仍然需要一条路。

tip: ship 作动词是“运送”。

senses.en: a person you do not know

ex.en: A stranger asked for the library.
ex.zh: 一个陌生人问路去图书馆。

ex.en: Teach students to ask an adult, not to follow a stranger.
ex.zh: 教学生去问成年人，而不是跟着陌生人走。

tip: strange 已在本库。本条不写跟踪或伤害的做法。

senses.en: the part of the body between the shoulder and the hand
to provide with weapons or tools

ex.en: She carried the books in one arm.
ex.zh: 她用一只胳膊抱着书。

ex.en: A chair with no arm is cheaper, and it is harder for some students to stand up from.
ex.zh: 没有扶手的椅子更便宜，有些学生也更难从上面站起来。

tip: arm 作动词是武装。家具的扶手也叫 arm。

senses.en: a dark shape made when light is blocked

ex.en: The tree throws a shadow on the path.
ex.zh: 树在小路上投下影子。

ex.en: A shadow on the crossing is not a light.
ex.zh: 路口的阴影不是灯。

col: in the shadow of｜在……的阴影里
tip: shadow 可数。

senses.en: an adult female person

ex.en: A woman from the clinic spoke to our class.
ex.zh: 诊所的一位女士给我们班讲了话。

ex.en: A woman who works a night shift still needs a safe way home when the last bus has gone.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妇女在末班车走后，仍然需要一条安全的回家路。

tip: woman 的复数是 women，读音也变。

senses.en: coming immediately after

ex.en: The next bus leaves in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 下一班车十分钟后开。

ex.en: The next step after collecting data is to ask whether the sample left anyone out.
ex.zh: 收集数据之后的下一步，是追问样本是否漏掉了什么人。

tip: next week 前不加 the；the next week 常指过去某个时间之后的一周。

senses.en: a medicine, or an illegal substance

ex.en: The drug must stay in the school clinic.
ex.zh: 这种药必须放在校医务室。

ex.en: Health class should say clearly that a drug from a doctor is not the same thing as an illegal drug.
ex.zh: 健康课应当讲清楚：医生开的药和非法毒品不是一回事。

tip: drug 既可以是正规药物，也可以是毒品。写作时要加修饰语，避免含糊。

senses.en: a seed of a cereal, or a tiny piece

ex.en: The grain is stored in the barn.
ex.zh: 谷物存在仓里。

ex.en: A grain of truth in a rumour still needs a source.
ex.zh: 谣言里的一点真实，仍然需要来源。

tip: grain 作谷物时可数也可不可数。

senses.en: not fair

ex.en: The rule is unfair to night workers.
ex.zh: 这条规则对夜班工人不公平。

ex.en: An unfair fee shows up when only one class can pay it.
ex.zh: 只有一个班付得起时，不公平的费用就显出来了。

tip: fair 已在本库。

senses.en: the organisation that keeps public order

ex.en: The police helped the children cross the road.
ex.zh: 警察帮助孩子们过马路。

ex.en: Police cannot be the only answer to a dark street; lights and pavements matter too.
ex.zh: 警察不能是黑暗街道的唯一答案；灯和人行道也很重要。

tip: police 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。一个警察用 a police officer。

senses.en: not old

ex.en: The young trees need water every evening.
ex.zh: 这些小树每天晚上需要浇水。

ex.en: Young workers leave a town when the only jobs are far away and poorly paid.
ex.zh: 当仅有的工作又远又报酬低时，年轻工人会离开城镇。

tip: the young 表示年轻人这一类，谓语用复数。

senses.en: to say numbers in order, or to be important
an act of counting

ex.en: Count the chairs before the parents arrive.
ex.zh: 家长到之前先数椅子。

ex.en: Every voice should count when a class decides how to share one practice room.
ex.zh: 班级决定如何共用一间练习室时，每个声音都应当算数。

tip: count on somebody 表示依靠某人。count 也可作名词“计数”。

senses.en: the facts of a particular time

ex.en: The situation is better than last week.
ex.zh: 情况比上周好。

ex.en: The situation on a flooded street is not the same as the situation on a dry planning map.
ex.zh: 积水街道上的情况，和干燥的规划地图上的情况不一样。

col: in a situation｜处于某种情况
tip: situation 是可数名词。

senses.en: a picture made by a camera

ex.en: She took a photo of the old bridge.
ex.zh: 她给旧桥拍了张照片。

ex.en: A photo of a clean park can hide the street where the rubbish was taken.
ex.zh: 一张干净公园的照片，可以藏起垃圾被运去的那条街。

tip: photo 是 photograph 的简写，复数是 photos。

senses.en: every person

ex.en: Everybody in our class joined the clean-up.
ex.zh: 我们班每个人都参加了打扫。

ex.en: Everybody needs a seat at the meeting if the decision will change their bus home.
ex.zh: 如果决定会改变他们回家的公交，每个人都需要在会上有一个座位。

tip: everybody 后接单数动词。和 everyone 同义，本库两条都保留。不要写成 every body（每一具身体）。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft

ex.en: The pilot spoke before the plane left.
ex.zh: 飞机起飞前飞行员讲了话。

ex.en: A school visit to an airport should meet the pilot and the person who loads the bags.
ex.zh: 学校参观机场应当见到飞行员，也应当见到装行李的人。

tip: pilot 也可指试点：a pilot programme。

senses.en: to keep doing something

ex.en: Please continue reading after the break.
ex.zh: 休息后请继续阅读。

ex.en: If factories continue to pour waste at night, daytime clean-ups will not save the river.
ex.zh: 如果工厂继续在夜里排污，白天的清理也救不了这条河。

tip: continue 后接 to do 或 doing 都可以。

senses.en: a person who investigates a case

ex.en: The detective in the novel checks the clock.
ex.zh: 小说里的侦探核对了钟。

ex.en: In the story, the detective arrives after midnight.
ex.zh: 故事里，侦探在午夜之后才到。

tip: 本条是阅读词汇。不写调查或作案的做法。

senses.en: a round citrus fruit, or its juice
of a colour between red and yellow

ex.en: She ate an orange at the break.
ex.zh: 课间她吃了一个橙子。

ex.en: Orange juice that is mostly sugar should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 主要是糖的橙汁应当在标签上写明。

tip: orange 作水果可数，作颜色或果汁时常不可数。形容词是橙色的。

senses.en: a place where films are shown; British

ex.en: The cinema opens at noon.
ex.zh: 电影院正午开门。

ex.en: The cinema shows a short film before the main feature.
ex.zh: 电影院在正片之前放一部短片。

col: go to the cinema｜去看电影
tip: 英式 cinema。美式常说 the movies。

senses.en: a sports game, or a small stick for making fire
to fit or be equal to

ex.en: The football match is on Saturday.
ex.zh: 足球赛在周六。

ex.en: A cup match brings visitors, but the town still needs bins and buses after the final whistle.
ex.zh: 杯赛带来观众，但终场哨响后城镇仍需要垃圾桶和公交。

col: a box of matches｜一盒火柴
tip: match 作动词是“匹配”。win a match，不说 win sb。

senses.en: the basic law of a country, or the body's condition

ex.en: The class read one article of the constitution.
ex.zh: 班级读了宪法的一条。

ex.en: A strong constitution in a child still needs sleep, not only sport.
ex.zh: 孩子体质好，仍然需要睡眠，而不只是运动。

tip: constitution 可指宪法，也可指体质或章程。不要和 constituent 混淆。

senses.en: the organ that pumps blood, or the centre

ex.en: Regular walks are good for the heart.
ex.zh: 经常走路对心脏有好处。

ex.en: A market in the heart of a town keeps daily life there; a mall on the edge can empty the centre.
ex.zh: 镇中心的市场维持着那里的日常生活；边缘的商场可能掏空中心。

tip: by heart 表示靠记忆，不是“靠心脏”。

senses.en: a vehicle or firework that is driven upward by burning fuel

ex.en: The textbook shows a rocket and a diagram.
ex.zh: 课本展示火箭和一张图。

ex.en: A lesson about a rocket should stay with the diagram, not a method.
ex.zh: 关于火箭的课应当停在图上，而不是做法。

tip: 本条是科普词汇。不写如何制造或发射。

senses.en: to stop for a short time
a short stop

ex.en: Pause the video when you need to copy the diagram.
ex.zh: 需要抄图的时候先把视频暂停。

ex.en: There was a pause while the judge checked the photo, and then the race continued.
ex.zh: 裁判核对照片时停了一下，然后比赛继续。

col: pause for a moment｜停一会儿
tip: pause 是短暂停一下，不是结束。结束用 stop 或 finish。

senses.en: not wet
to make or become dry

ex.en: Hang the coats where they can dry.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在能晾干的地方。

ex.en: A dry year raises the price of vegetables before it empties the school taps.
ex.zh: 干旱的一年会先抬高菜价，然后才会让学校的水龙头没水。

tip: dry 作动词是使变干。

senses.en: written works, especially those valued as art

ex.en: We read literature from more than one country.
ex.zh: 我们读的文学不止来自一个国家。

ex.en: Literature class is richer when the list includes writers the textbook forgot.
ex.zh: 如果书单包括课本忘掉的作家，文学课会更丰富。

tip: literature 通常不可数。

senses.en: words changed from one language into another

ex.en: The translation is on the right.
ex.zh: 译文在右边。

ex.en: A translation of the bus notice helps the parent who does not read the first language.
ex.zh: 公交通知的翻译能帮助读不懂第一种语言的家长。

tip: translation 可数。

senses.en: wanting food

ex.en: The class was hungry before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前班级饿了。

ex.en: A hungry student cannot use a speech about diet as a meal.
ex.zh: 饥饿的学生不能把一篇关于饮食的讲话当成一餐。

tip: hungry 是形容词。名词是 hunger。

senses.en: the state of continuing to live

ex.en: Survival after the flood depended on a dry room.
ex.zh: 洪水后的幸存靠的是一间干房间。

ex.en: The survival of a small shop depends on the rent.
ex.zh: 小店能否留下来取决于租金。

tip: 动词 survive 已在本库。survival 通常不可数。

senses.en: before now

ex.en: The museum closed two years ago.
ex.zh: 博物馆两年前关门了。

ex.en: A factory that shut ten years ago can still leave chemicals in the soil beside a school.
ex.zh: 十年前关闭的工厂，仍可能把化学物质留在学校旁边的土壤里。

tip: ago 用于过去时，放在时间段后面：three days ago。不与现在完成时连用。

senses.en: fully grown, or behaving in a sensible adult way
to become fully grown

ex.en: The plan is mature enough to name a person.
ex.zh: 这个计划成熟到能写出一个人的名字。

ex.en: A mature reply admits a mistake.
ex.zh: 成熟的回答会承认错误。

tip: mature 也可作动词“成熟”。

senses.en: the sweet part of a plant

ex.en: The canteen has fruit on Monday.
ex.zh: 食堂周一有水果。

ex.en: Fruit that students can take without paying is a policy, not only a bowl.
ex.zh: 学生可以不付钱拿走的水果是一项办法，而不只是一只碗。

tip: fruit 作总称通常不可数。a fruit 可指一种水果。

senses.en: shaped like a circle
around
one stage of an event

ex.en: They sat at a round table.
ex.zh: 他们坐在圆桌旁。

ex.en: A round of talks about the river should include the farms upstream, not only the city.
ex.zh: 关于这条河的一轮会谈应该包括上游的农场，而不只是城市。

col: all the year round｜一年到头
tip: 英式里 round 常作介词“围绕”；美式多用 around。

senses.en: a male child

ex.en: Her son walks to school with a neighbour.
ex.zh: 她儿子和邻居一起走路上学。

ex.en: A son who leaves for the city may still send money home, but the village loses his daily help.
ex.zh: 去城市的儿子也许仍会寄钱回家，但村子失去了他日常的帮忙。

tip: son 的复数是 sons。

senses.en: personality; a person in a story
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Honesty is part of his character.
ex.zh: 诚实是他性格的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: something that may happen or be true

ex.en: There is a possibility of rain.
ex.zh: 有下雨的可能。

ex.en: The possibility of a late bus should be written down before the trip, not during it.
ex.zh: 晚班车的可能性应当在出行前写下来，而不是在途中。

tip: possible 已在本库。possibility 是名词，后接 of 或 that。

senses.en: not one and not the other of two
not either of two

ex.en: Neither answer is fully right.
ex.zh: 两个答案都不完全对。

ex.en: Neither the early bus nor the late one stops at the new housing block.
ex.zh: 早班车和晚班车都不在新建的住宅区停。

tip: neither 作主语时谓语常用单数。nor 已在本库。

senses.en: a special day or period of public celebration

ex.en: The town festival is next weekend.
ex.zh: 镇上的节日在下个周末。

ex.en: A school festival should name which dates belong to which community, and not assume one calendar.
ex.zh: 学校的节日活动应当写明哪些日子属于哪个群体，而不假定只有一种日历。

tip: festival 可数。on the festival 不如 at the festival 或 during the festival 常见。

senses.en: to get something that is given or sent

ex.en: I received your message this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上收到了你的信息。

ex.en: Students who receive help early are less likely to hide a problem until the exam.
ex.zh: 早点得到帮助的学生，不太会把问题藏到考试。

tip: 拼写是 receive：c 后面是 ei。收到并不等于接受，接受用 accept。

senses.en: a supporting structure, or a set of ideas

ex.en: The framework of the essay is three points.
ex.zh: 这篇作文的框架是三个要点。

ex.en: A framework for the bus plan should include the return time.
ex.zh: 公交计划的框架应当包括返回时间。

tip: framework 可数。

senses.en: perhaps

ex.en: Maybe we can meet after the club.
ex.zh: 也许我们可以在社团活动后见面。

ex.en: Maybe a later school start would help, but only if buses change their times too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改时间才行。

tip: maybe 是一个副词；may be 是情态动词加动词，要分开写。

senses.en: a point given for work, or a sign
to write a sign, or to give a score

ex.en: She got a high mark in the reading test.
ex.zh: 她阅读测验得了高分。

ex.en: A single mark on one test should not decide whether a student can join the science club.
ex.zh: 一次测验的一个分数，不该决定学生能否参加科学社团。

tip: mark 作动词是“做标记”或“打分”。

senses.en: a metal container for food, in British English

ex.en: She opened a tin of peaches for the picnic.
ex.zh: 她为野餐打开一听桃子罐头。

ex.en: The tin had been on the shelf for two years, so we did not eat what was inside.
ex.zh: 这个罐头在架子上放了两年，所以里面的东西我们没吃。

col: a tin of peaches｜一听桃子
tip: 参考表写英式「罐头，听头」。锡这种金属也叫 tin，本卡按表先记罐头。美式罐头常说 can。

senses.en: the worth or importance of something
to think something is important

ex.en: The old map still has value for the history class.
ex.zh: 这张旧地图对历史课仍有价值。

ex.en: The value of a library is not only the books, but the quiet hour it gives after school.
ex.zh: 图书馆的价值不只是书，还有它在放学后提供的安静一小时。

tip: value 作动词是“重视”或“估价”。

senses.en: a person who follows Islam
of Muslims or Islam

ex.en: The museum explains how local Muslims mark the festival.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解当地穆斯林如何过这个节日。

ex.en: A school calendar that names one holiday should also leave room for a Muslim student to be absent for another.
ex.zh: 只写一个节日的校历，也应当给穆斯林学生为另一个节日请假留出空间。

tip: Muslim 作名词和形容词都要大写。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a formal talk, or the power of speaking

ex.en: Her speech at the ceremony was three minutes.
ex.zh: 她在典礼上的演讲只有三分钟。

ex.en: A speech that names no fact can still sound confident, which is why the class checks sources.
ex.zh: 一篇不提事实的演讲仍可能听起来自信，所以班级要核来源。

tip: speech 表示一次演讲时可数。表示说话能力时不可数。

senses.en: the design of buildings

ex.en: The architecture of the hall is simple.
ex.zh: 礼堂的建筑很简单。

ex.en: Good architecture includes a door a wheelchair can use.
ex.zh: 好的建筑包括一扇轮椅能用的门。

tip: architecture 通常不可数。

senses.en: caring only about yourself

ex.en: Don't be selfish and take both pillows.
ex.zh: 别自私，别把两个枕头都拿走。

ex.en: A selfish roommate who never shares the snacks soon loses the others' trust.
ex.zh: 从不分享零食的自私室友，很快就会失去别人的信任。

tip: selfish 形容人只顾自己。副词 selfishly，名词 selfishness。

senses.en: a person who cooks
to prepare food by heating it

ex.en: The cook knows which students cannot eat nuts.
ex.zh: 厨师知道哪些学生不能吃坚果。

ex.en: A school cook who labels the food saves more trouble than a long speech about diet.
ex.zh: 给食物贴标签的学校厨师，比一篇关于饮食的长讲话更能省麻烦。

tip: cook 是人。炉具是 cooker。作动词是烹调。

senses.en: a large area of water surrounded by land

ex.en: We are not allowed to swim in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们不准在湖里游泳。

ex.en: A clean lake supports birds and a town's drinking water at the same time.
ex.zh: 干净的湖同时养活鸟类和一座城镇的饮用水。

tip: lake 是被陆地包围的湖。sea 是海。

senses.en: to show a feeling or idea in words
a fast train or delivery
travelling or sent very fast

ex.en: She could not express the idea in one sentence.
ex.zh: 她没法用一句话表达这个想法。

ex.en: Students who express a worry early give the school time to change the plan.
ex.zh: 早点说出担心的学生，给学校留下改变计划的时间。

tip: express 作名词或形容词可指快车或特快。

senses.en: a level used for judging
usual or accepted

ex.en: The school raised its safety standard.
ex.zh: 学校提高了安全标准。

ex.en: A national standard for school buses helps only if villages can afford to meet it.
ex.zh: 校车的国家标准只有在乡村负担得起时才有帮助。

tip: standard 作形容词是“标准的”。

senses.en: to or at a distance

ex.en: She put the phone away during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时她把手机收起来了。

ex.en: Moving factories away from rivers can protect drinking water for the towns downstream.
ex.zh: 把工厂迁离河流，可以保护下游城镇的饮用水。

tip: away 是副词，不单独接宾语；表示离开某地用 away from。

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or fruit

ex.en: The salad is on the left.
ex.zh: 色拉在左边。

ex.en: The salad uses beans from the school garden.
ex.zh: 这份色拉用的是学校园子里的豆子。

tip: salad 可数。

senses.en: inside a limit of time, distance, or area

ex.en: Please reply within three days.
ex.zh: 请在三天内回复。

ex.en: A clinic within walking distance saves families the cost of a long bus ride.
ex.zh: 步行能到的诊所，能为家庭省下长途公交的费用。

col: within reach｜在够得着的范围内
tip: within 强调不超过某个范围；in 更一般。

senses.en: a test done to learn something
to do a test

ex.en: The experiment is on the board.
ex.zh: 实验写在黑板上。

ex.en: An experiment without notes cannot be repeated by the next class.
ex.zh: 没有笔记的实验，下一班无法重复。

tip: experiment 作动词是做实验。本条不写危险操作。

senses.en: the front of the chest, or a part of the body

ex.en: The clinic form uses the word breast in a medical sense.
ex.zh: 诊所表格在医学意义上使用 breast 这个词。

ex.en: A health lesson can name the breast and still stay respectful.
ex.zh: 健康课可以提到胸部，同时仍然保持尊重。

tip: breast 是身体部位的普通词。本条用医务和课堂的说法，不写其他内容。

senses.en: a polite word for a man

ex.en: The gentleman held the door.
ex.zh: 那位先生扶住了门。

ex.en: Ladies and gentlemen is a greeting, not a rule about who may speak.
ex.zh: Ladies and gentlemen 是称呼，不是关于谁可以发言的规定。

col: ladies and gentlemen｜女士们先生们
tip: 复数是 gentlemen。

senses.en: to put a hand on something
an act of touching, or the sense

ex.en: Do not touch the wet paint on the door.
ex.zh: 别碰门上还没干的油漆。

ex.en: A museum that lets students touch a copy of an old tool teaches more than a glass case alone.
ex.zh: 让学生触摸一件古工具复制品的博物馆，比只有玻璃柜教得更多。

tip: keep in touch 表示保持联系，不是身体接触。

senses.en: to ask someone to come or to do something

ex.en: Invite the new student to the table.
ex.zh: 邀请新同学到这张桌子来。

ex.en: A school should invite the parent who works nights, and then choose a time they can come.
ex.zh: 学校应当邀请上夜班的家长，然后选一个他们能来的时间。

tip: 名词常用 invitation。本库目前是动词 invite。

senses.en: the same in size, value, or rights
to be the same as

ex.en: The two teams had an equal chance.
ex.zh: 两队机会相等。

ex.en: Equal time at the microphone matters when one class is louder than the other.
ex.zh: 当一个班比另一个班更吵时，话筒前相等的时间就很重要。

tip: equal 作动词是等于。be equal to 还可表示胜任。

senses.en: to leave a place or stop doing something

ex.en: He did not quit the team; he was ill.
ex.zh: 他没有退出队伍，他是病了。

ex.en: Students who quit a subject in silence give the school no chance to help.
ex.zh: 默默放弃一门课的学生，没给学校留下帮忙的机会。

tip: quit 后接 doing，不接 to do。过去式仍是 quit。

senses.en: to encourage something, or to care for a child in your home

ex.en: The club fosters a reading habit.
ex.zh: 社团培养学生的阅读习惯。

ex.en: Foster care should name the adult who meets the child.
ex.zh: 寄养应当写明来接孩子的成年人。

tip: 表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: including many different kinds

ex.en: The class is diverse.
ex.zh: 这个班是多样的。

ex.en: A diverse reading list still needs books the library actually has.
ex.zh: 多样的书单仍然需要图书馆真的有的书。

tip: diverse 是形容词。表里标成动词，本库按形容词写。

senses.en: a doctor

ex.en: The physician is in the clinic.
ex.zh: 医生在诊所。

ex.en: The physician noticed the fever and called home.
ex.zh: 医生发现了发烧，并给家里打了电话。

tip: physician 比 doctor 更正式。本条不写诊疗步骤。

senses.en: the writer of a book or article

ex.en: The author of the article is a local teacher.
ex.zh: 这篇文章的作者是一位本地老师。

ex.en: An author who hides their name makes it harder to judge the facts.
ex.zh: 隐瞒姓名的作者让人更难判断事实。

tip: author 是可数名词。

senses.en: the joint between the hand and the arm

ex.en: She wore a watch on her left wrist.
ex.zh: 她左手腕上戴着一块表。

ex.en: The ball hit his wrist, not his fingers, and he could not write for a day.
ex.zh: 球打中的是他的手腕，不是手指，他一天没法写字。

tip: wrist 是手腕。腰是 waist，还在考纲里，尚未收入本库。

senses.en: to have to pay or give something

ex.en: I owe her a clear answer by Friday.
ex.zh: 我周五之前要给她一个清楚的答复。

ex.en: We owe the library two books from last term.
ex.zh: 我们欠图书馆上学期的两本书。

tip: owe 不用于被动来表示“被欠”时要小心：常用 somebody is owed。

senses.en: a country, or a people

ex.en: The nation celebrates this day in October.
ex.zh: 这个国家在十月庆祝这一天。

ex.en: A nation that funds rural schools changes who gets to sit a university exam.
ex.zh: 资助乡村学校的国家，会改变谁有机会参加大学考试。

tip: nation 强调人民或政治共同体。country 更常指国土。

senses.en: to act or play for an audience, or to do a duty

ex.en: The choir will perform on Friday.
ex.zh: 合唱团周五演出。

ex.en: Schools perform better when the first bus arrives before the bell.
ex.zh: 如果第一班车在铃响前到达，学校会运转得更好。

tip: 名词 performance 已在本库，可指演出，也可指表现。

senses.en: a device for speaking to someone at a distance

ex.en: I left my phone in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把电话落在教室了。

ex.en: A phone warning about a storm helps only the people who still have power and a signal.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的手机警报，只帮助那些还有电和信号的人。

tip: phone 作动词是“打电话”：phone sb。

senses.en: a substance used with water for washing

ex.en: There is soap by the sink.
ex.zh: 水槽边有肥皂。

ex.en: Soap in the school washroom matters more than a poster about cleanliness.
ex.zh: 学校洗手间里的肥皂，比一张讲清洁的海报更重要。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: soap 作材料通常不可数。

senses.en: the quality of being amusing; American spelling

ex.en: Her humor made the wait shorter.
ex.zh: 她的幽默让等待变短了。

ex.en: The play is full of quiet humor.
ex.zh: 这出戏里有不少轻巧的幽默。

tip: humor 是美式，humour 是英式。本库词头用考纲里的 humor。

senses.en: a wild animal with long legs

ex.en: The deer is in the nature book.
ex.zh: 鹿在自然课本里。

ex.en: The deer crossed the road just after dawn.
ex.zh: 鹿在黎明刚过时穿过了马路。

tip: 单复数同形。

senses.en: the quality of being important

ex.en: The importance of sleep is in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 睡眠的重要性在第一章。

ex.en: The importance of the last bus is clear on the day it does not come.
ex.zh: 末班车没来的那天，它的重要性就很清楚。

tip: important 已在本库。be of importance 等于 be important，更正式。

senses.en: to have a plan in mind

ex.en: I intend to finish the graph before dinner.
ex.zh: 我打算晚饭前把图表做完。

ex.en: The note was short, but she intended it as an apology, not as an excuse.
ex.zh: 条子很短，但她的本意是道歉，不是找借口。

tip: intend to do。intended 常表示「有意的」，不是单纯的过去。

senses.en: to fail to catch, or to feel sad someone is away

ex.en: I missed the early bus this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我错过了早班车。

ex.en: Students miss more than a lesson when a flood closes the only road to school.
ex.zh: 当洪水封了唯一的上学路，学生错过的不只是一节课。

tip: Miss 大写是对未婚女性的称呼，和动词 miss 不同。

senses.en: rising or falling sharply

ex.en: The path up the hill is too steep for the bus.
ex.zh: 上山的路太陡，公共汽车上不去。

ex.en: Steep stairs behind the hall have no rail, so we use the front door.
ex.zh: 礼堂后面的陡楼梯没有扶手，所以我们走前门。

tip: 山陡用 steep。价格高得过分也可以说 a steep price，参考表这一行是险峻、陡峭。

senses.en: to send something through the air with the hand

ex.en: Do not throw bags on the stairs.
ex.zh: 不要把包扔在楼梯上。

ex.en: Players who throw the ball too hard in a small hall break both windows and the game.
ex.zh: 在小礼堂里扔球太用力的人，既会打碎窗户，也会毁掉比赛。

tip: throw 的过去式是 threw，过去分词是 thrown。

senses.en: to go from one place to another
the activity of travelling

ex.en: We travel to school by bus.
ex.zh: 我们乘公交去上学。

ex.en: Waste can travel downstream farther than the factory that produced it.
ex.zh: 废物可以向下游流到比产生它的工厂更远的地方。

tip: travel 作名词“旅行”通常不可数。

senses.en: to come after, or to obey

ex.en: Follow the signs to the hall.
ex.zh: 按指示牌去大厅。

ex.en: Students follow a timetable, but the buses they need may follow a different one.
ex.zh: 学生遵守课表，但他们需要的公交可能遵守另一份时刻表。

tip: follow 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，通常不加 to。
